**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Gender Preference:** Male

Create high-quality AI-generated images, videos, and marketing materials.  
Develop engaging social media content, advertisements, and promotional videos.  
Use AI tools to create innovative digital campaigns.  
Edit and enhance AI-generated visuals using professional design software.  
Collaborate with marketing teams on creative concepts and branding.

2–5 years of experience in creative design, multimedia, or digital content creation.  
Hands-on experience with **Midjourney, Runway, Kling AI, Adobe Firefly, or similar AI tools**.  
Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut.  
Strong knowledge of AI prompt engineering, image generation, and video production.  
Experience in social media marketing and digital advertising.  
**AI creative portfolio is mandatory.**

Pay: AED7,000.00 - AED12,000.00 per month

* Do you have experience in using Midjourney, Runway, Kling AI, Adobe Firefly, or similar AI tools.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut.
* Strong knowledge of AI prompt engineering, image generation, and video production.

Experience:

* Ai creative content: 3 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* AI creative portfolio (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior AI Video Editor & Generative Video Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior AI Video Editor & Generative Video Specialist

Department: Marketing

Seniority Level: Senior

Reports to: Marketing Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative Senior AI Video Editor & Generative Video Specialist to lead the production and post-production of high-quality video content using professional editing software, artificial intelligence tools, and generative video technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong video editing expertise, creative storytelling, visual design, and hands-on experience with AI-powered production workflows. This role is responsible for transforming marketing briefs, campaign concepts, product information, and brand strategies into compelling video content that strengthens brand awareness, drives engagement, and supports commercial objectives.

The candidate will be expected to independently manage projects from concept development to final delivery, while continuously exploring new AI technologies to improve creative quality, production speed, and cost efficiency.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Video Editing and Post-Production

Edit high-quality videos for social media, digital advertising, e-commerce, corporate communications, and brand campaigns.

Produce short-form and long-form content, including Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube content, promotional videos, product showcases, and corporate videos.

Apply professional techniques in storytelling, pacing, transitions, sound design, color correction, color grading, and visual effects.

Transform raw footage, scripts, product assets, and creative briefs into polished, publication-ready videos.

Adapt master videos into multiple formats, aspect ratios, lengths, languages, and platform-specific versions.

Maintain consistent visual quality and brand identity across all video deliverables.

B. AI-Powered Video Production

Use generative AI tools to create original video sequences, visual concepts, backgrounds, environments, animations, and supporting footage.

Develop AI-assisted workflows for image-to-video, text-to-video, video enhancement, scene generation, and creative experimentation.

Leverage AI tools for voiceovers, subtitles, transcription, dubbing, translation, audio enhancement, and localization.

Use AI-powered tools for rotoscoping, object removal, background replacement, upscaling, frame interpolation, and other post-production tasks where appropriate.

Create realistic and visually consistent AI-generated assets while maintaining quality control over motion, lighting, anatomy, product details, and continuity.

Evaluate emerging AI video platforms and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into the marketing production process.

Ensure that AI-generated content meets brand standards, platform requirements, copyright obligations, and applicable usage restrictions.

C. Creative Development and Storytelling

Collaborate with the Marketing Manager and wider marketing team to translate campaign objectives into creative video concepts.

Develop storyboards, visual references, editing approaches, and production plans based on campaign briefs.

Propose innovative ways to communicate product benefits, brand values, cultural stories, and commercial messages through video.

Create engaging opening hooks, clear narratives, and strong calls to action appropriate to each campaign objective.

Experiment with creative formats, AI-generated visual styles, motion graphics, and new storytelling techniques.

Maintain a strong understanding of visual trends, platform behavior, and evolving digital content formats.

D. Performance Marketing and Social Media Content

Produce video creatives for paid media campaigns across relevant digital advertising platforms.

Develop multiple creative variations for A/B testing, including different hooks, messages, visuals, durations, and calls to action.

Collaborate with the Paid Media and Performance Specialist to improve creative effectiveness based on campaign performance.

Develop platform-specific content optimized for audience retention, completion rates, engagement, click-through rates, and conversions.

Analyze video performance and apply insights to future creative decisions.

Support organic social media content production with consistent, timely, and engaging video assets.

E. E-commerce and Product Marketing

Produce product demonstration videos, promotional videos, product explainers, and e-commerce advertising creatives.

Create AI-assisted product visuals and video assets while preserving the accuracy of product appearance, materials, proportions, packaging, and branding.

Support the creation of promotional bundles, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and other commercial initiatives.

Develop reusable creative templates and scalable video formats for recurring marketing campaigns.

Collaborate with design and e-commerce teams to ensure that visual assets support product presentation and conversion objectives.

F. Workflow Management and Quality Control

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting agreed deadlines and creative priorities.

Maintain organized project files, source assets, editable timelines, export versions, and final deliverables.

Establish efficient workflows for AI-assisted production, editing, feedback, revisions, and asset management.

Ensure that all deliverables meet technical specifications, brand guidelines, and quality standards before publication.

Identify opportunities to reduce production time, external production costs, and repetitive manual work through automation and AI.

Document effective workflows and share best practices with the marketing team.

G. Collaboration and Creative Leadership

Work closely with the Marketing Manager, Social Media Manager, Paid Media Specialist, Brand Designer, and other relevant stakeholders.

Provide creative recommendations and technical guidance on video production and AI-generated content.

jobs.title: Head of Brand Partnerships- Middle East & Africa
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet the team**  
We know the impact experiences have on lasting memories. That's why, we help brands connect in a meaningful way with their audience through culturally resonant campaigns.

Operating like a creative agency, our team uses their expertise in entertainment and immersive events to help brands and agencies across the globe **conceptualize, produce, and manage multi-channel campaigns** that give audiences experiences they will remember.

We craft **bespoke strategies** that blend branded content, digital storytelling, ticketed experiences, and premium sponsorships, tailored to each market.

Join us if you're excited to shape global campaigns, craft stories that connect with people everywhere, and bring top brands to life through unforgettable immersive experiences.

**The role**

As our Head of Brand Partnerships for Middle East and Africa based in our Dubai office, you will play a pivotal role in growing Brand Partnerships across the MEA region. Leveraging an established market position, you will build long-term relationships with top brands, media agencies, and strategic partners.  
Reporting to the Global Head of Brand Partnerships, you will collaborate closely with global functions including Media, Strategy, Creative Solutions, Production, Finance, Data & Insights, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to develop and execute scalable brand partnership opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the company's presence across the Middle East and Africa.

#### **What you'll do**

* Closing high-value sponsorships and media partnerships with leading brands.
* Securing multi-year partnerships for major Originals and premium events.
* Elevating the company's position as the premier experiential-media platform in Iberia.
* Building robust, insight-driven sales strategies and exceeding revenue goals.
* Maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities that drive year-over-year growth.
* Develop and maintain senior decision-maker relationships across brands, agencies, and sponsorship consultancies.
* Proactively secure and negotiate partnerships leveraging media, experiential, and data capabilities.
* Lead MEA revenue targets, forecasting pipeline health and conversion rates.
* Collaborate internally to create and execute high-impact branded activations, media packages, and content integrations.
* Analyze market trends and audience insights to craft tailored commercial strategies.
* Represent the Middle East and Africa in global strategy alignment, ensuring local insights influence cross-market offerings.
* Lead client meetings, negotiations, and presentations with confidence and strategic insight.
* Mentor and develop a high-performing Brand Partnerships team in the MEA region.
* Track and report on performance metrics, ensuring accountability and continuous optimization.

#### **Who you are**

Experience & Expertise

* 15+ years in partnerships, media sales, sponsorship, or experiential marketing.
* Proven track record of securing scaled partnership deals with top-tier brands and agencies.
* Strong network across Middle East and Africa brand and agency ecosystems.

Skills & Abilities

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills.
* Experience leading commercial teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to structure win-win partnerships.
* Data-driven mindset, comfortable using insights for strategy and storytelling.
* Fluent in English; Arabic a plus but not essential.

#### **Why you'll love it here**

* Attractive compensation package, including stock options to reward your contributions and growth.
* Opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* Professional and personal growth from day one with real responsibility.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Private health insurance with Allianz-Orient: 100% covered by Fever.
* Air ticket: 2100 AED payment for each year of service.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

  

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
